children: UK data platform's half-year revenue grew 4% yr/yr, with underlying growth of 1%
Adjusted EBITDA for the half-year rose 5%, margin improved to 34%
Company returned over £49 mln to shareholders via buybacks and tenders
GlobalData expects FY26 underlying revenue growth at the lower end of market expectations
Company sees FY26 Adjusted EBITDA below market expectations, with margins in line with H1
GlobalData expects a more cautious recovery in margins in the medium term than previously stated
ACQUISITIONS & ONE-OFFS - Reported revenue growth was mainly driven by recent acquisitions and a one-off complimentary period revenue adjustment
CHALLENGING MARKET - Company said underlying revenue growth was limited by a challenging macroeconomic backdrop and elongated sales cycles
SUBSCRIPTION RESILIENCE - Subscription revenue grew 6%, supported by robust renewal rates, while non-subscription revenue declined due to discontinued and disposed non-core assets
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 6 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the professional information services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for GlobalData PLC is GBp130.00, about 81.6% above its September 11 closing price of GBp71.60
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 13 three months ago
